notes: This is the classic Pete the Cat story where Pete's white shoes change colour as he steps in piles of strawberries (red), blueberries (blue), and mud (brown). Core repetitive elements are colour changes and Pete's song 'I love my white/red/blue/brown shoes.' Colour words are CENTRAL to the story and are high-priority fringe. 'Sing' is essential as Pete sings throughout. 'Puddle' or 'mud' represents the wet bucket — 'puddle' was chosen as more picturable and general. 'Cool' captures Pete's signature attitude ('goodness no, it's all good'). If the exact book title cannot be confirmed as Eric Litwin's, verify authorship — the slug suggests it may be a variant or classroom adaptation titled simply 'Pete White Shoes.'
